svg.desc: NET-10-results. Canvas origin (25,20); SVG uses the top-left origin. Production bottom-left: unchanged Browse panel (24,24), 802 by 544, with title chrome unchanged; body edges inset 8 px from its outer frame, leaving 4 px inside the bevel even with a 2 px focus keyline. Heading (32,490), 786 by 20; list (32,248), 786 by 242; preserve ten rows at 22 px pitch. Mode is second; Access combines admission and protection without changing either input. Details (32,108), 786 by 128, retain 8 px inner padding and 12 px list separation. Full identity, mode, protection, endpoint and necessary ongoing feedback fit inside the border. Refresh (706,518), 112 by 24, remains in place. Footer: Join selected (32,32), Direct connect (300,32), Back (568,32), each 250 by 32 with 18 px gaps. Conditional Previous/Next page use (32,72)/(568,72), each 250 by 24. Paging is hidden in this single-page representative. Keep removed captions absent, selection/focus distinction, current traversal, hidden-input rules, eligible protected ongoing joining, bound setup, discovery, admission and recovery unchanged.
